_comment: Template. The real file lives at ~/.one-shot-app/config.json (created on first use, chmod 600), never in the skill folder or a repo, never printed. Secrets are entered with `setup.py secret <field>` in the user's own terminal. Phase 4 (preflight.py --modules …) only requires the fields the ticked modules need. Personal, non-secret data lives in ~/.one-shot-app/profile.json.

developer._required: appleTeamID, bundleIdPrefix, githubOwner (if GitHub is ticked)
developer._appleTeamID: The TEAM id (ASC → Membership). Not the personal id shown on the signing certificate (both are 10 characters; take the one from ASC → Membership).
developer._appleAccountEmail: The Apple ID that owns the developer account. The app record is created by `rc setup apple` in the user's terminal (Apple ID password + 2FA typed by the user, never by the assistant).

appStoreConnect._comment: REQUIRED. App Store Connect → Users and Access → Integrations → App Store Connect API → generate a team key with App Manager access. The .p8 downloads exactly once; put it somewhere outside any repo and point privateKeyPath at it. Phase 0 loads it into the Superwall ASC proxy (`superwall asc keys set`) so app records and subscriptions can be created without minting a local JWT, and Phase 8 base64-encodes it straight from this path into the GitHub secret. The file is never copied into a repo and never printed.

revenuecat._comment: Driven by the `rc` CLI (`brew install revenuecat/tap/rc`, `rc auth login`). Always --project-id, never change the default project, never the RevenueCat MCP or dashboard. apiV2Key is only a fallback for assets/scripts/revenuecat.py if rc is unavailable.

superwall._comment: The `superwall` CLI holds its own OAuth session (`superwall login`). Paywalls are written as code (`superwall create`, `npx superwall@latest publish`); the app also ships a native fallback paywall.

gemini._comment: Optional. Icon concepts, translations, abstract textures, short video clips, all only within the run's spend cap. Gemini never draws UI, text or devices. A Gemini subscription does not fund this API key; a 429 'spending cap' means raising the cap in Google Cloud. Models: gemini-3-pro-image, gemini-3.1-flash-image, gemini-omni-1.2-flash (video), gemini-2.5-flash (text).

netlify._comment: Optional fallback website host. Cloudflare is the default.

github._comment: The autonomous review loop. reviewer must be the literal string 'Copilot' — the API rejects 'copilot-pull-request-reviewer' with 422. With autoMerge true the skill merges its own PR once CI is green and Copilot's comments are addressed, which is what triggers the App Store upload.

appStoreDeploy._comment: When true, Phase 8 arms APP_STORE_DEPLOY_ENABLED so a merge to main archives and uploads. The workflow still fails harmlessly until the app record and subscriptions exist in App Store Connect.

supabase._comment: Only needed when the app requires a backend. Access token from supabase.com/dashboard/account/tokens.

cloudflare._comment: Default backend + website host. `npx wrangler login` once. workersSubdomain is the <x>.workers.dev part.
